def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    ones = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 1]
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in ones), max(r for r, c in ones)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in ones), max(c for r, c in ones)
    shape = [[grid[r][c] == 1 for c in range(c0, c1 + 1)]
             for r in range(r0, r1 + 1)]
    sh, sw = len(shape), len(shape[0])

    # Identify the separate palette object, away from the 1 template.
    other = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
             if grid[r][c] and grid[r][c] != 1]
    pr0, pr1 = min(r for r, c in other), max(r for r, c in other)
    pc0, pc1 = min(c for r, c in other), max(c for r, c in other)

    # Palette is a rectangular stripe whose entries encode copy colors.
    if pr1 - pr0 <= pc1 - pc0:
        # Each row of the palette is the ordered sequence of colors.
        palette = [grid[pr0][c] for c in range(pc0, pc1 + 1)]
    else:
        # Each column carries one color; read across the palette columns.
        palette = [grid[pr0][c] for c in range(pc0, pc1 + 1)]

    # Collapse repeated identical palette rows (horizontal sequence), or
    # use the constant-color columns of a vertical sequence.
    if pr1 > pr0 and all(
        [grid[r][c] for c in range(pc0, pc1 + 1)] ==
        [grid[pr0][c] for c in range(pc0, pc1 + 1)]
        for r in range(pr0, pr1 + 1)
    ):
        palette = [grid[pr0][c] for c in range(pc0, pc1 + 1)]
    else:
        palette = [grid[pr0][c] for c in range(pc0, pc1 + 1)]

    index = palette.index(1)
    out = [[0] * w for _ in range(h)]
    for i, color in enumerate(palette):
        top = r0 + (i - index) * sh
        for dr in range(sh):
            for dc in range(sw):
                rr, cc = top + dr, c0 + dc
                if shape[dr][dc] and 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w:
                    out[rr][cc] = color
    return out

    # Find repeated nonzero row that forms the palette.
    palette = None
    for r in range(h):
        seq = [v for v in grid[r] if v]

            palette = seq
            break

    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in comp), max(c for r, c in comp)
